**Analysis of the Paper Under Review:**
The paper under review (FedBiOT) addresses a real problem (federated fine-tuning of LLMs while protecting IP and data), correctly identifies a limitation of prior work (FedOT's emulator is fixed and drifts), and proposes a reasonable fix (continuous emulator alignment during FL).
